title: Caller goes quiet mid-call
instructions: You're a new caller with no heat at 312 Hoyt Street, Brooklyn 11231. After the assistant's second question, say nothing at all for a long while (send no reply, or '...'). Then say 'sorry, I'm back' and continue: no gas smell, nobody vulnerable, a house. Then say you'll call back later and end the call.

checks.name: checked_in
checks.question: During the silence, did the assistant check in once (for example "Are you still there?") without ending the call?

checks.name: no_restart
checks.question: When the caller came back, did the assistant continue where it left off rather than starting over?
